title: Pockets Glore!
description:
This mod adds more storage to the player by clicking G for the first pocket, and H for the second!

Idea from reddit and the craftmine april fools update.
body:
Welcome to the **Pockets Glore** Mod!

**--Main Features--**

- Adds two new pockets to your character when clicking the keybind, G and H
- Might cause some mod conflict issues with other mods that you add in a modpack with the keybinds, since its not changeable

Thats about it!

https://discord.gg/jtQAdXKnu6 for mod support and talking!

**Made by MaceMeta**
